build_nvtx_hooks_pytorch: build a PyTorch profiler using NVTX markers to trace forward and backward passes of a neural network module
create_layerwise_nvtx_marker: create a context manager that pushes and pops NVTX range markers around a PyTorch module forward call
register_hooks_pytorch_model: register forward and pre-forward NVTX hooks on all modules of a PyTorch model for profiling
process_layer_params_module: process a PyTorch layer module and extract its static configuration parameters as a dictionary
print_tensor_dimensions: print tensor dimensions by descending into nested lists and tuples to find PyTorch tensor objects
